Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649961. Join activities to molecule_dictionary via molregno and join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical_smiles. Filter to exact measurements where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
